bayts.text: O You to Whom belong the magnifying and the sanctifying: through You Iblīs has made for others than us.
O You to Whom belongs pre-eminence like dominion: You have preserved me from the harm of kings.
O You to Whom belongs creation as the affairs belong to Him: You have spared me by grace the harm of every emir.
O You Who through me benefit whoever visits: You have protected me, and no minister has harmed me.
O You to Whom belongs "Be", and it is, O King: You have protected all of me from the hardships of the spiritual path.
The enemies have known that I am with You, not with them, glad tidings for Your host.
You made me patient (in abstaining) from the unlawful already before, and the temptation of people has vanished, and the fetter.
You made me patient in the face of every hateful thing, when I was a stranger, and made the heart good.
You made me patient (in abstaining) from all that does not benefit of permitted things, and I used to repel them.
You made me patient in obeying Your command; You drove my enemies toward others than me by Your might.
You subdued my soul for me, You subdued my desire for me, and evil and misguidance You drove toward others than me.
From You is my provision toward the Gardens, with what You chose for me of favours.
I have renounced the unlawful and the reprehensible, with a preservation from You, together with making them hateful.
You drove toward others than me all in which there is no use, and (made) my life a leader toward good.
You conveyed to me the joy of the pious, You protected me from the harm of the wicked.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ) and All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm),
bless with a blessing that takes away illnesses toward others than us and sets the aims right,
with a peace that sets hearts right and draws curdled milk and milk,
upon him through whom You folded for me the distance of the spiritual path, O Possessor of favour.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bear witness to my gratitude to You on the day of Tarwiya, O You Who gave me to drink of quenching outpourings,
and before it and after it; and bear witness for me to the best of good, and lead Your good pleasure to me.
And raise my letters with gratitude, O Appreciative, O Best of Him with Whom a servant converses intimately in gratitude.
None but You can enumerate Your praise, O Everlasting Who made me abide, O Reckoner (Al-Muḥṣī).
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ), the Keeper (Al-Ḥāfiẓ),
bless with a blessing already clear of turbidity, O Creator by Whose leave the decree flows,
with a peace that is only from You, by whose blessing You grant me "Be", and it is,
upon him who removes the bringers of toil toward a direction other than mine, forever, like disgrace.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And guard Islām through me with a guarding that has never been for others than me, and be for me with "Be".
And guard my six directions, O Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ), O You to Whom belong my meaning and the word.
And guard in my breast the beneficial sciences, and make my life beneficial to the Prophet,
may He bless him forever and grant him peace, He through Whom he taught my heart.
And grant me memory without forgetting, and preserve my life through him from disobedience.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Rich (Al-Ghanī) and Enricher (Al-Mughnī),
bless with a blessing that frees from Your enemies and from other than what You chose for me, O Enricher,
with a peace that leads Your host to me, (I) a slave made rich by the Book with You,
upon him by whose standing You spared me what has grieved and whoever did evil.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me the veneration of all whose veneration is due, O You Who lead wonder to me.
O You Who protected me from what I know, of what grieves me, and from what I do not know.
Take away faults toward other than my person, and lead to my heart the outpouring and the mysteries.
And grant me today, without despoiling, "Be", and it is; overcome my enemies for me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Near (Al-Qarīb) and All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ),
